title: Context object, array or null
description: Where the document carries an @context at its top level, the value is a context object, an array of context objects, or null. An array may also hold null, which JSON-LD reads as clearing what came before it. A string, which JSON-LD reads as the web address of a context to fetch, is reported by remote-contexts-absent, so this expectation is assessed only once that one is met.
summary: The `@context`, if present, is an object, an array of objects, or `null`
